data.hypothesis: Replacing the modulo/shared-memory reduction tree with warp shuffles, one shared-memory write per warp, and one cross-warp combine may lower block-local overhead while preserving the 128-element tile and recursive host stages. This is a testable hypothesis; the baseline timings do not identify the local reduction as a bottleneck. Unsigned modulo-2^32 partials avoid signed overflow, and the final int32-fit condition makes the resulting bit pattern exact.

memory_lessons.applicability: The baseline establishes a comparison point for this reduction, but not which part of the program limits performance.
memory_lessons.claim: The baseline was correct on its 10 supplied cases and measured a 46.244 μs mean across three runs; this does not establish a local-reduction speedup opportunity.
memory_lessons.next_experiment: Measure this warp-first candidate with the same full-program protocol and compare correctness and repeated timings against the baseline.

data.notes: No candidate attempt has been run, so there are no candidate correctness results, failed attempts, or full-program timings to report yet. The supplied baseline was valid and correct on 10 cases (n=1, 127, 1024, 65536, 4194304; two seeds), with times 46.5651, 46.0806, and 46.0864 μs (mean 46.2441 μs). The baseline did not test n=0; this implementation writes zero asynchronously for n<=0. The current T1 catalog has no candidate results or source-diversity evidence. Controller validation and repeated timings remain outstanding.
transformations: Replaced the modulo/shared-memory tree with a warp shuffle reduction, four warp partials in shared memory, and a first-warp cross-warp combine.
Used unsigned 32-bit modular arithmetic for every partial and __uint_as_int for bit-preserving partial storage, avoiding signed intermediate overflow when the final int32 sum is representable.
Retained 128-thread tiles, tail zero-fill, recursive host stages, the existing scratch-bank offsets, the run ABI, and default-stream ordering; added asynchronous zero output for nonpositive n.
